Subject: Pipeline stitch + account summaries — prep for QBR readout

Team —

With the QBR readout two weeks out, we need a concise, validated pipeline and per-account narrative to present to execs and finance. I want a single consolidated forecast and short, one-page notes for each named account (ask/next step, win-barriers, confidence, skew in timing).

Immediate asks:
- Forecast stitch: please merge today’s committed/likely numbers into forecast_rollup.csv (attached). Use ARR motion and indicate any timing risk (move-ins to next quarter).
- Account one-pagers: prepare a 200–300 word summary for each account listed below, with current ask, next milestone, and a recommended ask for the execs. Attach as PDF or Google slide.
- Focus accounts (priority): Acme Corp, HelixPay, Orion Analytics. For Acme specifically, we need procurement timing and expected PO date.

Deadlines: consolidated forecast by EOD Thurs 6/11; account one-pagers by EOD Fri 6/12. I will compile a 2-slide executive summary for the QBR deck on Monday.

Attachments: forecast_rollup.csv (template), QBR_account_notes.xlsx (seed notes).

Notes: mark any deal moves >$200k as red and include rationale. If you need to reclassify a commit -> likely, flag me and include why.

Thanks —
Markus Klein
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

- Flagged Orion Analytics as high risk: technical POC dependency unresolved.

I started the one-pager for Acme Corp — draft attached as executive_one_pagers.pdf. Short summary: buyer org stands, legal review underway, procurement expects PO within two weeks but will confirm. I noted the suggested ask: six-week pilot with SLA add-on.

- For Acme (DEAL-5821) I recommend we show two scenarios: base (PO by 6/25) and downside (PO slips to Q4). That explains the variance and preserves credibility.
- If we have final procurement language from Acme, include it in the one-pager; otherwise note outstanding legal items.
